## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (74%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert

Reliability check flagged the image; conformal set has three classes. [F6]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 74%, Normal 16%, InSitu 6%, Benign 5% | Clear lead only |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu, Invasive | Three classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.25; OOD 68th percentile | Input flagged suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Both models agree |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors mostly disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Modest positive association · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Positive association; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Benign-leaning cue; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytes** (regions 0, 4, 5) · context · Descriptive only; spot check 8/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown faithful. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability 0.25 flags the input; probabilities may be miscalibrated for this image.
- Normal or in situ remain possible: both are in the conformal set; 4 of 5 neighbors disagree.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 7, 11** — confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma versus in situ growth.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7** — verify mitoses yourself; concept spot check was 0/20.
3. **Regions 0, 8, 9** — confirm normal lobules are present; concept spot check was 0/20.
